source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005, ss.1, 13, 39 (Wikisource mirror)

regulator.notes: A new general pension fund (קרן חדשה כללית) is a provident fund for annuity (s.1) that is not entitled to designated bonds or the guaranteed-return mechanism; managing companies are under the Commissioner's supervision (s.39(א)).

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 3(ב) (Hebrew Wikisource; Nevo mirror)

deposit.notes: Maximum fee on payments to a new general pension fund. The fee on money transferred from the comprehensive fund may not exceed the member's comprehensive-fund rate unless agreed otherwise (PEN-10); the selected-fund tender terms do not cover the general fund (Meitav page, institution).

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 3(ב) (Hebrew Wikisource; Nevo mirror)

balance.notes: Maximum fee per year of balance in a new general pension fund; pensioners 0.6% (pensions from 2013), 0.3% for old-age pensions from 1 February 2022.

labels: blocked: annuity conversion factors not collected (PEN OQ7); the page shows the gross balance and the exemption rule (G-03)
an early withdrawal is taxed at the higher of 35% and the marginal rate, on the whole amount paid (TXP-18); F-48 is not in the engine yet, so it is not computed (G-06, closed 2026-10-26)
one tax category with the comprehensive fund (TXP-24)

source.title: Retirement Age Law 2004, s.5 (early retirement age, 60 for men and women) (Wikisource mirror); Mor comprehensive pension fund bylaws 01.06.2025, s.1 "גיל זכאות מינימלי לקצבת זקנה" and s.41

age.notes: Minimum old-age eligibility age, 60 (early retirement age); the general fund's bylaws follow the comprehensive fund's structure for the pension itself (PEN-10, PEN-27). Insured salary for benefits is capped at 4 times the average wage (PEN-09).

source.title: תקנות מס הכנסה (כללים לאישור ולניהול קופות גמל), התשכ"ד-1964, p.16, reg. 41יא(א)

payout_business_days.notes: Rule 41יא(א) of the 1964 Income Tax Rules: a provident fund pays a withdrawal within 4 business days of the day the request reaches it; if that date falls in the month's first three business days it may defer to the 4th business day of the month. The law's timetable for every fund, not one company's (scope pass 2026-10-25). The CMA standard pension bylaw repeats it (s.108(ז)).

lawful_exit.text: the lawful exit is an old-age pension from the minimum eligibility age, 60 (early retirement age); before that only the severance component on leaving a job and the narrow cases in the law (small balances past mandatory retirement age, pre-2000 money, health and income conditions) can be taken as a lump sum; any other withdrawal is a non-compliant withdrawal taxed at the higher of 35% and the marginal rate, on the whole amount paid (TXP-18); F-48 is not in the engine yet, so early withdrawal is not computed; the annuity itself needs conversion factors that are not collected (PEN OQ7), so the exit value is blocked too (F-49, G-03) and the page shows the gross balance with the exemption rule as text; the general fund has no guaranteed-return share (PEN-18)

source.title: Income Tax Regulations (Rules for Approval and Management of Provident Funds) 1964, reg. 33ב (Wikisource mirror); Mor general fund bylaws 01.04.2026; Income Tax Ordinance s.9(2)

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Track switch inside the fund within 3 business days, not a withdrawal; the member is taxed only at exit. Transfer between pension funds: tax neutrality not stated in the tax rule base (SW OQ8).

transfer_routes.condition: not while still an active member of the general fund (transfer regulations reg. 4); up to the comprehensive monthly ceiling
between annuity funds; the pooled insurance cover does not move

eligibility.text: a member of a new comprehensive pension fund whose monthly deposits exceed the comprehensive ceiling is joined to the same manager's general fund automatically for the excess, from the date it is received, with written notice within 14 days of the first transfer and the option to buy insurance cover on that part of the salary

protection.text: assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and cannot be attached; if the company fails, management moves to another company; the state does not guarantee the fund's value; unlike the comprehensive fund, the general fund has no state guaranteed-return share; balances are adjusted by actuarial balancing
